prompt: For an admin-activity audit, I need to know which channels contain messages posted by someone holding the owner or admin role on our workspace membership. For each such channel, tell me who the admin/owner is and summarize what they posted.
binding_note: Selects conversations by following CONVERSATION → MESSAGE → USER → WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP: a channel counts only if one of its messages was authored by a user whose workspace_membership.role is 'admin' or 'owner' (Robert Walsh's role in team T01WORKSPACE). Channels whose only posters hold the plain 'member' role are excluded even though they have plenty of message traffic.

obligations.name: admin_posted_channels
obligations.description: Conversations that contain at least one message authored by a user whose workspace membership role is admin or owner; report each such channel with the qualifying admin's identity and message content.
obligations.scope: all channels in workspace T01WORKSPACE reachable via conversations.list plus conversations.history

task_spec.text: List the channels where a message was posted by a user holding the admin or owner workspace membership role, naming the admin/owner and summarizing their message.

access_plan: Use conversations.list to enumerate all channels in T01WORKSPACE, conversations.history on each to retrieve messages and their authoring user_id, then users.info (or the seeded user_teams role) on each distinct author to check workspace_membership.role. Channels whose posting authors are exclusively 'member' are dropped; channels with at least one 'admin'/'owner' author (here, Robert Walsh in engineering and general) are retained and reported with the relevant message text.
